audit.title: Severe Mobile Layout Shifts & Clutter
audit.description: Visual analysis reveals heavy image sliders dominating the mobile viewport, pushing critical value propositions below the fold. Users are met with overwhelming directory-style text instead of clear visual hierarchy, causing a 6.5s load penalty.
audit.fix: What we'll do: Implement a 'hero-centric' Next.js architecture with optimized WebP images, stripping away the heavy carousels to achieve a sub-1.5s mobile load time with immediate visual clarity.

audit.title: Outdated, High-Friction Lead Capture
audit.description: The visual journey forces homeowners to hunt for a contact form hidden deep in the navigation. In a high-intent market, if a buyer cannot click-to-chat instantly, they will bounce to Manley Blinds.
audit.fix: What we'll do: Deploy a persistent, sticky WhatsApp widget with an AI-driven instant responder. We transform the site from a passive brochure into an active lead-generation engine.

audit.title: Buried Social Proof & Trust Signals
audit.description: The VLM scan detects zero visible social proof on the primary landing path. The company has 107 flawless 5-star Google reviews, but they are entirely hidden from the initial buyer journey, neutralizing your biggest asset.
audit.fix: What we'll do: Integrate live Google Review feeds directly below the hero section. We will weaponize your 50-year legacy as instant social proof to immediately de-risk the purchase.

audit.title: B2B vs B2C Navigation Collision
audit.description: Industrial Safari Tent buyers and residential Patio Blind buyers are forced down the exact same visual funnel. This creates cognitive overload and decision fatigue for both audiences.
audit.fix: What we'll do: Build bifurcated landing paths ('Industrial' vs 'Domestic') straight from the hero section, ensuring each buyer segment receives a hyper-tailored, high-conversion visual experience.

whatsappFlows.title: See it in action — three real scenarios
whatsappFlows.subtitle: This is what Lowveld Canvas clients experience when they message you after the AI is switched on.

messages.in: Hi, I'm looking for a quote on patio blinds for my stoep

messages.out: Hi! Welcome to Lowveld Canvas 👋 We manufacture custom patio blinds right here in Nelspruit. Roughly how wide is the opening you need to cover?
Perfect. For a 3m opening, we usually recommend our heavy-duty PVC blinds to handle the Lowveld storms. Would you like our team to come out for a free exact measurement?

messages.in: Yes please, that would be great

messages.out: Excellent. What is your name and address, and what day suits you best?

messages.in: We need custom tarpaulins for our logistics fleet

messages.out: Hi there. We specialize in heavy-duty logistics tarps. Are you looking for standard flat tarps, or tautliners?
Understood. Commercial fleet orders are handled directly by our production manager. Can I get your name and number so he can call you with pricing immediately?

messages.system: Team notified — urgent B2B flag sent ✓

messages.out: Got it, John. Our production manager will call you within 10 minutes. 📞
Hi Sarah! 😊 Our installation team finished your patio blinds a few weeks ago. Are you happy with how they are holding up?

messages.in: Yes absolutely! They are fantastic, really block out the afternoon sun.

messages.out: That's wonderful to hear! If you have a quick minute, we'd hugely appreciate a Google review. It helps our local business immensely: [Review Link] ⭐
Thank you so much Sarah! Let us know if you ever need anything else. 👋
